setupBody: This page checks the server, then loads data from files or the web.
unreadableResponse: The server sent an answer the app cannot read.
serverNotAnswering: The server did not answer. Check that corpus-kb is running.
unknownOperation: That operation is not in the manifest.
unavailableBody: The server cannot run this yet. You can retry in a moment.
runnerUnknownOutcome: The connection dropped. The server may still be working.
runnerCancelled: You stopped waiting. The op may still run on the server.
runnerStatusEmpty: The server sent no status message.
runnerParamsHint: The request fields go here as JSON.
confirmLongBody: This can take minutes. You can stop waiting at any time.
badgeDegradeNote: Thresholds were missing, so the answer is not verified.
stagePlaceholderBody: This stage arrives with the next update. Use Setup to load data first.
setupDoctorDbDown: The database is not reachable. Ingest and search will not work.
setupDoctorOllamaDown: The model server is not reachable. Ingest ends with weak embeddings. Ask shows sources without an answer.
setupDoctorChecksNone: The database checks did not run. Fix the database first.
setupDemoBody: Load five short sample files through the standard pipeline. This fills the library for a first try.
setupDemoConfirmBody: This can take a minute. Files already loaded are skipped.
setupUploadBody: Pick files from this machine. They go through the standard ingest pipeline.
setupUploadCap: Each file can be up to {mb} MB.
setupUploadTooLarge: That file is over the {mb} MB cap. Pick a smaller file.
setupIngestTitle: Ingest from the server or the web
setupIngestDirTitle: Ingest a folder on the server
setupIngestDirBody: Ingest every supported file under one folder. The folder must exist on the machine that runs corpus-kb.
setupIngestUrlBody: Fetch one web page, or crawl pages on the same domain.
reviewBody: Check the corpus health, review coded units, and browse the discovered topics.
reviewDocsNotWired: The document list is not wired yet. The server manifest has no read route for documents.
reviewDegradedNone: No degraded chunks. Every stored chunk has a vector.
reviewDegradedCounts: {chunks} chunks and {vectors} vectors lack usable embeddings. Re-embed them now, or when the model server is back.
reviewQueueBody: Confirm or overrule the model assignments, one row at a time.
reviewQueueEmpty: No assignments wait for review. Run a coding pipeline first, or go on to Ask.
reviewReviewerHint: Your name is saved in this browser and sent with each decision.
reviewOverrideBody: Your decision and note replace the model assignment. The model answer stays on record.
reviewNoteRequired: A note is required to override.
